Steps write only there; reset = delete what a step wrote there. Issued inputs are read in place and never modified.

steps.do:
Run the repository's own validation recipe through the wrapper (it takes about a minute here; allow up to ten):
node orchestrate/tools/validate.mjs --spec .agents/changes/OS-20260923-mechanical-tools/evidence/C1/inputs/issue-001/I-02/spec.json --log ../c1-scratch/c1-validate-repo.log --timeout 570
steps.pass: Exactly one output line beginning PASS tests ; exit code 0; the log file exists and ends with the reporter's summary, whose ℹ fail is 0 and whose ℹ skipped equals the line's total minus its passed count (0 on Windows; on Linux 2, the Windows-only pair in tests/validate.test.cjs).
steps.aside: Corrected at this close-out (revision 2). Revision 1 required passed = total, which the line cannot show on Linux: its total counts skipped tests (PASS tests 497/499 here). The QA runner failed revision 1 on exactly that and passed everything else about it.
